The candidates supported bringing street vendors back. Gutierrez and Bermudez proposed a committee or commission that included vendors; Bermudez emphasized self-policing and giving sellers more power. Hernandez called for residents, merchants, vendors, cultural associations and city departments to devise a plan, while Torres and Brown proposed designated vending spaces. Fielder called for vendors to have a voice and to be protected from criminalization.
